acquisition.semantics: Earliest100ns window on fixed10ns grid whose every later window also qualifies; confirmation is its end, not exact physical lock instant
acquisition.scope: Finite nominal acquisition screen only; no phase-noise/jitter, PVT, thermal-equilibrium, extracted-layout or foundry qualification

agreement.scope: Binary64 expression-order comparison only; all100ppm/50ps/control/ordinal decisions must be exactly equal

limitations: This is one nominal finite transistor-level acquisition screen; paired 2.5ps run is separate and pending. Both previous 400ns failures remain unchanged.
Phase span is not zero phase error: biased finite RC loop retains a static phase offset. Earliest sustained window is a finite grid observation, not unconditional lock.
Full raw replay verifies all public binary64 samples and inherited 539 safety formulas; independent actual-edge/ordinal/window arithmetic is separately checked.
No PVT, jitter, phase noise, long thermal equilibrium, foundry SOA, extracted layout or full PLL/CDR qualification.
